features.quote: Termination: task_complete tool call OR turn budget
3. The model produces three consecutive turns with no tool calls (treated as a stall)
4. The model produces an output flagged by a content filter (logged as special termination)
Abort episodes at turn 15 if no tool calls in last 4 turns
features.justification_quote: this catches stalled episodes before burning the full budget

features.quote: A 10-turn budget would cut off many episodes mid-cascade; a 30-turn budget adds cost without much signal past turn 20
